info.title: dotnet-updatr
info.description: Tool to update NuGet packages. Supports package references and dotnet-tools.json.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Update all packages in solution or project(s).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --package
options.description: Package to update. Supports * as wildcard. Will update all unless specified. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --exclude-package
options.description: Package to exclude. Supports * as wildcard. Merged with "excludePackages" from a .updatrrc file, if present. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --output
options.description: Format of the summary written to stdout. "text" (default) writes the human-readable, colored summary. "json" writes only machine-readable JSON to stdout - logs and any other diagnostic output are sent to stderr instead, so stdout can be safely piped to or parsed by another program. [default: Text]

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Writes the summary to a file. If an existing directory is given, an "output.md" file is created there. If a file path is given, its extension decides the format: ".md" for markdown, ".txt" for plain text, ".json" for machine-readable JSON, or ".html" for a standalone HTML page.

options.name: --title
options.description: Outputs title to path.

options.name: --description
options.description: Outputs description to path.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Log level. [default: Warning]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Do not save any changes. [default: False]

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Allow prerelease packages to be installed. [default: False]

options.name: --browser
options.description: Open summary in browser. [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Interaction with user is possible. [default: False]

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Bypass the local NuGet HTTP cache when checking for package versions, forcing every source to be queried fresh. [default: False]

options.name: --tfm
options.description: Lowest TFM to support.

options.name: --allowed-licenses
options.description: Only update to (and warn about) versions whose license contains one of these values, e.g. 'MIT'. Packages without license information are always allowed. Leave out to disable license checking. Merged with "allowedLicenses" from a .updatrrc file, if present. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --exclude-file
options.description: File to exclude, matched against its path relative to the resolved target. Supports * as wildcard. Merged with "excludeFiles" from a .updatrrc file, if present. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --align-with-tfm
options.description: Package to keep aligned with the project's target framework's major version, instead of updating to a newer version whose major just happens to also be compatible. Supports * as wildcard. Merged with "alignWithTfm" from a .updatrrc file, if present. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with a non-zero code if a finding of this severity or higher is found: "outdated" (any package was updated, is deprecated, or is vulnerable - most useful together with --dry-run), "deprecated" (deprecated or vulnerable) or "vulnerable". Defaults to "none", or "failOn" from a .updatrrc file, if present.

options.name: --fail-on-incomplete
options.description: Exit with a non-zero code if the run was incomplete, i.e. a package source returned 401 or a package couldn't be resolved on any source. Independent of --fail-on. Can also be set via "failOnIncomplete" in a .updatrrc file. [default: False]

arguments.name: ARGS
arguments.description: Path to solution or project(s). Defaults to current folder. Target can be a specific file or folder. If target is a folder then all *.csproj/*.fsproj/*.vbproj files, dotnet-tools.json-files and file-based apps will be processed. [default: .]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a .updatrrc file with all options present, but empty.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --example
options.description: Write a populated, realistic example instead of all options present but empty. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory to create the .updatrrc file in, or a file path to use directly. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to a .updatrrc file, or a directory to look for one in. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]
